title: Taming the Entropy Cliff: Variable Codebook Size Quantization for Autoregressive Visual Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.06207v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most discrete visual tokenizers rely on a default design: every position in the sequence shares the same codebook. Such a constant-codebook design can consume the finite-data entropy budget very quickly. We observe that the per-position empirical conditional entropy decays so quickly along the sequence that, after a few positions, the conditional distribution becomes essentially deterministic. On ImageNet with $K=16384$, this happens after only about 2 out of 256 positions, when most prefixes already identify individual images in the dataset. We call this phenomenon the Entropy Cliff. Under full conditional utilization, larger codebooks exhaust the finite-data entropy budget in fewer positions. The empirical entropy decreases more gradually in our language comparison, where the effective entropy per position stays below the codebook capacity. translated_title: 驯服熵悬崖：面向自回归视觉生成的可变码本大小量化
translated_abstract: 大多数离散视觉分词器依赖于一个默认设计：序列中的每个位置共享同一个码本。这种恒定码本设计会非常快速地消耗有限数据的熵预算。我们观察到，每个位置的经验条件熵沿着序列衰减得如此之快，以至于在几个位置之后，条件分布基本上变为确定性分布。在ImageNet上（K=16384）时，这种情况在256个位置中仅约2个位置之后就会发生，此时大多数前缀已经能够识别数据集中的单个图像。我们将这种现象称为“熵悬崖”（Entropy Cliff）。在条件被充分利用的情况下，较大的码本会在更少的位置耗尽有限数据的熵预算。在我们的语言对比实验中，经验熵的下降则更为平缓，每个位置的有效熵保持在码本容量以下。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可变码本大小量化（VCQ），其中码本……
tldr: 该论文发现离散视觉分词器中存在条件熵沿序列急剧衰减的“熵悬崖”现象，并提出可变码本大小量化（VCQ）方法，以解决恒定码本快速耗尽有限数据熵预算的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies the "Entropy Cliff" phenomenon—where conditional entropy in discrete visual tokenizers collapses to near-deterministic after only a few positions—and proposes Variable Codebook Size Quantization (VCQ) to prevent constant codebooks from rapidly exhausting the finite-data entropy budget.
